bai: Bai 16 thu thuat Excel 3/4: Dropdown thong minh, AutoCorrect, Co gian chu, Chong trung

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dung trong Data Validation Source de tham chieu toi Table co ten 'sp'. Them dong moi trong Table tu dong cap nhat dropdown.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tao Table tu A3:A8 dat ten sp; D11 Validation Source =INDIRECT("sp"); them GX06, GX07 tu hien

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Dat ten vung (Name Box): sp; Source: =sp (hoac F3 dan ten)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dat ten cho vung danh muc, Validation tham chieu ten. F3 hien danh sach ten de chon nhanh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den A4:A8, Name Box go sp > D12 Validation Source =sp; sua Name Manager bo tieu de neu thua

cong_thuc.giai_thich: OFFSET tao vung dong: bat dau tu A3 dich 1 hang, cao = so o co du lieu tru tieu de. Them SP moi tu cap nhat.
cong_thuc.vi_du: D15 Source =OFFSET($A$3,1,0,COUNTA($A:$A)-1,1); them GX06 tu co trong list. Neu moc A3 thi dich 1, moc A4 thi dich 0

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: File > Options > Proofing > AutoCorrect Options > Replace: gl With: Gai Excel > Add
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Go tat tu dong thanh cum day du. Tiet kiem khi nhap lap lai.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them gl->Gai Excel, gw->Gai Word; go gl + Enter thanh Gai Excel

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: File > Options > Proofing > AutoCorrect > chon quy tac > Delete
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chon quy tac cu, Delete de go bo.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon gl, Delete; go gl khong doi nua

cong_thuc.ten: Shrink to fit (co gian chu vua o)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Ctrl+1 > Alignment > tich Shrink to fit > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tu dong thu nho co chu de hien thi vua o, tranh tran trang in. Keo rong o thi chu tro lai co mac dinh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den cot thang (Ctrl de chon nhieu) > Format Cells > Shrink to fit; so ##### bien mat

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dem so lan xuat hien cua gia tri trong cot; chi cho phep <2 (khong trung). Ap dung Data Validation Custom cho ca cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon cot Ma NV > Validation Custom =COUNTIF($B:$B,$B1)<2; nhap NV001 lan 2 bao loi

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Data Validation > Error Alert > Style Stop, Title + Message
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tuy chinh thong bao khi nhap trung, vd 'Da co ma nhan vien nay'.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Error Alert Title: Trung ma; Message: Da co ma nay. Retry/Cancel khi vi pham

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Tao dropdown thong minh bang Table + INDIRECT
cac_buoc: Boi den nguon gom ca tieu de (vd A3:A8)
Insert > Table > tich My table has headers > OK
Doi ten Table thanh sp (Table Design)
O can dropdown: Data > Validation > Allow List > Source =INDIRECT("sp")
OK; them GX06/GX07 duoi Table tu co trong list
Boi den vung danh muc
Go ten sp vao Name Box > Enter
O can dropdown: Validation > Source =sp (hoac go =, bam F3 chon sp)
Neu thua tieu de: Formulas > Name Manager > Edit > sua vung A4:A8
Xac dinh o moc (vd A3 tieu de San pham)
Validation Source =OFFSET($A$3,1,0,COUNTA($A:$A)-1,1)
OK; kiem tra list tu GX01-GX05
Them GX06, mo dropdown thay da cap nhat; sua dich hang 1->0 neu moc la A4
File > Options > Proofing > AutoCorrect Options
Replace go gl, With go Gai Excel > Add (tuong tu gw->Gai Word)
OK > OK
Go gl + Enter tu doi thanh Gai Excel; muon xoa: vao lai > Delete

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Tu dong co gian chu vua o
cac_buoc: Boi den cac o can co gian (giu Ctrl de chon nhieu cot thang)
Chuot phai > Format Cells (Ctrl+1) > tab Alignment
Tich Shrink to fit > OK
Kiem tra: thu hep o chu nho lai, keo rong chu tro lai mac dinh
Chon cot/vung Ma NV
Data > Data Validation > Allow: Custom
Formula =COUNTIF($B:$B,$B1)<2
Sang tab Error Alert: nhap Title/Message 'Da co ma nay' > OK; thu nhap NV001 lan 2 se bao loi
